Dream 2026-11-22 linked 8 vignettes from 5 days to this record as evidence. Agree if they belong here; disagree to have a later dream drop them.

- 2026-10-27 · touches · "But affirmation will just kill lots of this work." (Navigability is semantic integrity; memory is layered and temporal; the dream cycle builds long-term memory by testing against scenarios (2026-10-27))
- 2026-10-28 · touches · "the real goal is to use the method editor and build the set of reusable components" (Prototype the affirmation editor in srs-lab? The goal is the method editor and reusable components (2026-10-28))
- 2026-10-30 · touches · "affirming things I can't review" (Vignette 2026-10-30: sovereignty is doing what I am good at)
- 2026-10-30 · touches · "Affirmation breaks the better version of the cycle." (Vignette 2026-10-30: AI should keep evolving clusters)
- 2026-11-04 · retells · "We may not want the whole affirmation requirement, but a tick and bin on derived data would be valuable." (Build up structured background from vignettes; a tick and bin instead of affirmation (2026-11-04))
- 2026-11-06 · retells · "Affirming everything just becomes a chore... and then I just click "recommended"." (Affirmations and vignettes are anchors; AI brings the coherence in between, and affirmation is rarer than we expect (2026-11-06))
- 2026-11-06 · touches · "This process is important, but killing me ;-)" (This process is important, but killing me (2026-11-06))
- 2026-11-06 · touches · "At the moment I still cannot properly work out how to manage affirmations." (Once the words are written they are hard for me to change, in this work too: I need to see my words next to what AI did, and I still can't manage affirmations (2026-11-06))
